title: Meta signs commercial AI data agreements with publishers to offer real-time news on Meta AI
description: Meta is partnering with CNN, Fox News, Fox Sports, Le Monde Group, the People Inc. portfolio of media brands, The Daily Caller, The Washington Examiner, and USA Today.
author: Aisha Malik

title: Chicago Tribune sues Perplexity
description: The newspaper is alleging copyright infringement and calling out Perplexity's retrieval augmented generation (RAG) as a culprit.
author: Julie Bort

title: All the biggest news from AWS’ big tech show re:Invent 2025
description: Amazon Web Services' giant tech conference re:Invent 2025 is happening this week with news ranging from chips to AI services.
author: Kirsten Korosec, Julie Bort, Rebecca Szkutak

title: Micro1, a Scale AI competitor, touts crossing $100M ARR
description: Micro1 started the year with roughly $7 million ARR. Now, it claims to have surpassed $100 million in ARR, double what it reported in September.
author: Tage Kene-Okafor

title: Anthropic CEO weighs in on AI bubble talk and risk-taking among competitors
description: Anthropic's CEO shared his thoughts on the economics of AI and the risk-taking of competitors, saying some were "YOLO-ing" with regard to spending.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Meta centralizes Facebook and Instagram support, tests AI support assistant
description: The new support hub will connect users to security tools, account recovery options, and an AI assistant.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Meta reportedly plans to slash Metaverse budget by up to 30%
description: The proposal reflects the overall lack of interest in products like Meta's social virtual reality platform, Horizon Worlds.
author: Amanda Silberling

title: Anthropic signs $200M deal to bring its LLMs to Snowflake’s customers
description: AI research lab Anthropic inked a $200 million deal with Snowflake to bring its AI models to Snowflake's 12,600 customers.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: EU investigating Meta over policy change that bans rival AI chatbots from WhatsApp
description: The European Commission is launching an antitrust investigation into Meta's move to ban other AI companies from using WhatsApp's business tools to offer their own AI chatbots to users.
author: Ram Iyer

title: AI finds its way into Apple’s top apps of the year
description: Although Apple has continued to avoid naming a dedicated AI app or AI chatbot as its app of the year, AI was showcased among this year's winners.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Nexus isn’t going all in on AI, keeping half of its new $700M fund for India startups
description: Nexus Venture Partners manages $3.2 billion in capital across its funds and has invested in more than 130 companies over the years.
author: Jagmeet Singh

title: All the biggest news from AWS’ big tech show re:Invent 2025
description: Amazon Web Services' giant tech conference re:Invent 2025 is happening this week with news ranging from chips to AI services.
author: Kirsten Korosec, Julie Bort, Rebecca Szkutak

title: Meta poaches Apple design exec Alan Dye to lead new creative studio in Reality Labs
description: Dye led Apple's user interface team for the last decade.
author: Amanda Silberling

title: Andy Jassy says Amazon’s Nvidia competitor chip is already a multibillion-dollar business
description: Can any company, big or small, really topple Nvidia's AI chip dominance? Maybe not entirely, but Amazon is already making big bucks trying.
author: Julie Bort

title: WordPress’s vibe-coding experiment, Telex, has already been put to real-world use
description: Though WordPress's Telex is still an experiment, the vibe-coding software has already been used to help build real-world websites.
author: Sarah Perez

title: VCs deploy ‘kingmaking’ strategy to crown AI winners in their infancy
description: While VCs have long used big investments to spur category winners, they are taking this strategy to new extremes.
author: Marina Temkin

title: Anthropic hires lawyers as it preps for IPO
description: Anthropic is reportedly prepping for an IPO that could come as early as 2026.
author: Dominic-Madori Davis

title: AWS doubles down on custom LLMs with features meant to simplify model creation
description: AWS is launching more capabilities in both Amazon Bedrock and Amazon SageMaker AI to make building custom models easier.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: Another bid to block state AI regulation has failed… for now
description: Republicans’ attempt to ban state AI regulations was removed from the defense bill after bipartisan opposition, underscoring tensions between tech-industry demands, consumer protection concerns, and Trump’s push for sweeping federal preemption.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Google Photos’ 2025 Recap turns to Gemini to find your highlights
description: The Google Photos Recap will use Gemini's AI to find your memorable moments throughout the year, and adds new metrics, like a 'selfie' count.
author: Sarah Perez
